titulo.alumno: Source and statement · He said that…

intro: Part 3: source and statement. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Ifølge lederen bliver planen ændret i juni.
frases.alumno: According to the manager, the plan will change in June.

frases.estudio: Medarbejderne siger, at de mangler flere oplysninger.
frases.alumno: The staff say that they need more information.

texto: In reported speech, «at» introduces a statement and «om» can introduce a yes/no question. The tenses do not change mechanically: keep the meaning and the time reference of the text.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
